card.name: Digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit partway through a long identifier or count, such as a grant number, trial ID, hash or study population size. Also fires on some name pieces inside citation author names.

modes.label: Digit inside an ID
modes.description: One digit in the middle of a grant, trial, or hash string.

modes.label: Digit in a study count
modes.description: A digit within a number of study participants.

modes.label: Author name piece
modes.description: Middle of a surname in a reference list.
modes.example: Ronca F, Palmieri L, Panic<<ucci>> P, Ronca G.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a long reference number or count, where the rest of the number is still to come.
